items.docs: Retrieve a collection of security groups configured in the Workday tenant. Supports filtering by security group type, status, and search terms. Returns security group metadata including type, membership count, and associated domain security policies.

info.name: Workday Security Get a specific security group

params.name: securityGroupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the security group

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific security group including its type, members, and associated domain security policies.

info.name: Workday Security List members of a security group

params.name: securityGroupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the security group

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieve the collection of users and integration system users that are members of the specified security group. Returns member details including account information and assignment metadata.

info.name: Workday Security List domain security policies

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: search
params.description: Search term to filter policies by domain name or description

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of domain security policies configured in the Workday tenant. Domain security policies define which security groups have access to specific Workday functional domains and what level of access is granted, such as View or Modify permissions.

info.name: Workday Security Get a specific domain security policy

params.name: policyId
params.description: Unique identifier of the domain security policy

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific domain security policy including the security groups with access and their permission levels.
